summary: 霍巴特的古今艺术博物馆把古物与当代作品放进别具一格的地下展厅。作者从家乡的变化写起，讨论建筑和策展如何吸引游客，以及塔斯马尼亚能否延续这一文化影响。
logic: 家乡文化吸引力的变化
追问城市如何延续影响

paragraphs.brief: 住在澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚这个小岛国的18岁老人，搬到“大陆”的速度不够快。
sentences: As an eighteen-year-old living in the small Australian island state of Tasmania, moving to the ‘mainland’ could not happen soon enough.
住在澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚这个小岛国的18岁老人，搬到“大陆”的速度不够快。
Now, ten years later, I look forward to going home.
10年后，我期待着回家
This is probably because I’ve grown up, but also perhaps because the cultural landscape of Tasmania has matured.
可能是因为我长大了，也可能是因为塔斯马尼亚的文化景观已经成熟。
The latest addition to Tasmania’s cultural scene is David Walsh’s Museum of Old and New Art (MONA), a museum that has established Hobart, the capital city of Tasmania, on the global art circuit.
在塔斯马尼亚文化场景中，最新增加的是大卫·沃尔什的旧艺术和新艺术博物馆(MONA)，该博物馆将首都塔斯马尼亚的霍巴特建立了全球艺术圈。

paragraphs.brief: 这栋建筑是艺术和建筑如何对一个地方的社会和文化声誉产生即时影响的一个例子。
sentences: This building is an example of how art and architecture can have an instant impact on the social and cultural reputation of a place.
这栋建筑是艺术和建筑如何对一个地方的社会和文化声誉产生即时影响的一个例子。

Andrew Bain of The Sydney Morning Herald wrote, ‘In a virtual blink, Hobart’s cultural landscape has been transformed, with art, wine, fine food and stylish accommodation becoming integral features of the city … If Hobart’s makeover has an origin, it’s the opening of MONA – the Museum of Old and New Art.’
悉尼早晨报的安德鲁·贝恩写道："在虚拟的瞬间，霍巴特的文化景观已经转变，艺术，葡萄酒，精致的食物和时尚的住宿成为城市的重要特征...如果霍巴特的改造有起源，旧艺术和新艺术博物馆"。
MONA is said to have been solely instrumental in the reinvention of Hobart as a cultural hub.
据说，MONA只是帮助重新塑造Hobart文化中心。

paragraphs.brief: MONA在开放前就制作了国家新闻和国际博客。
sentences: MONA made the national press and international blogs before it opened.
MONA在开放前就制作了国家新闻和国际博客。
After that, Tourism Industry Council of Tasmania’s chief executive, Luke Martin, claimed that MONA was proving so popular it was underpinning the tourism industry in Tasmania.
之后，塔斯马尼亚州首席执行官Luke Martin的旅游业理事会声称，MONA被证明非常受欢迎，它支撑着塔斯马利亚州的旅游业。
However, MONA’s effect on Hobart has broader ramifications for Tasmania’s tourism industry.
但MONA对Hobart的影响对塔斯马尼亚的旅游业有更广泛的影响。
As reported in Hobart’s local paper, The Mercury, there is concern about how long people are staying in Tasmania.
正如Hobart的当地报纸《水星》所报导，人们担心塔斯马尼亚人会逗留多久。
Rather than spending a week in the state and hiring a car to experience the beauty of the Tasmanian landscape, people are making short stays in Hobart only to visit the gallery.
游客不再花上一周时间租车欣赏塔斯马尼亚的风景，而只在霍巴特短暂停留，专程参观这座美术馆。
The next challenge for the state is how to entice holiday-makers to stay longer, and to venture further afield.
国家面临的下一个挑战是如何吸引节日制作人多呆一段时间，并冒险到更远的地方去。
Tasmania is more than a one-hit wonder.
塔斯马尼亚不仅仅是个奇迹

paragraphs.brief: 据Martin说，正在调查是否可能将MONA包装成参观塔斯马尼亚周围其他画廊。
sentences: According to Martin, possibilities for packaging up MONA with visits to other galleries around Tasmania are being investigated.
据Martin说，正在调查是否可能将MONA包装成参观塔斯马尼亚周围其他画廊。

Although not directly related to these investigations, the 1891 Queen Victoria Museum and Art Gallery at Royal Park in Launceston is currently being restored to its original condition; there are also plans to extensively redevelop the Tasmanian Museum and Art Gallery in Hobart.
虽然与这些调查没有直接关系，但劳恩斯顿皇家公园的1891年维多利亚女王博物馆和美术馆目前正在恢复原状；还计划广泛重新开发霍巴特的塔斯马尼亚博物馆和美学馆。
In addition to this, there are up to twenty other existing quality galleries in the state.
除此之外，该州还有多达20个现有的高质量画廊。
So there is more to see than just MONA.
所以，我们不仅需要看到MONA，而且需要看到更多。

paragraphs.brief: 这座建筑虽然很大，但相当没有描述，严重地坐在德文特河的边缘。
sentences: Although large, the building is rather nondescript, sitting heavily on the edge of the Derwent River.
这座建筑虽然很大，但相当没有描述，严重地坐在德文特河的边缘。
MONA’s ‘wow factor’ comes from the notoriety of David Walsh, the museum’s millionaire founder, and his choice of unusual artworks.
博物馆的百万富翁创始人David Walsh的名声以及他对不寻常艺术品的选择都代表了MONA的"坏因素"
The architecture has more depth of meaning and does exactly as it should: it supports the vision of the museum, essentially the vision of Walsh.
建筑具有更深的含义，而且完全照样运作：它支持博物馆的愿景，主要是沃尔什的愿景。
It’s a new building in the context of a maturing city.
这是一座在成熟的城市里的新建筑。
The dark, moody labyrinth of gallery spaces could be likened to the mind of the eccentric founder himself.
画廊空间的阴暗、情绪迷宫可以比喻到古怪的创始人的头脑
Each artwork appears to be integrated into the dark materiality of the architecture – the interiors are far from light, bright and neutral, as might be seen in a more traditional gallery.
每件艺术品似乎都融入了建筑的黑暗物质性之中 — — 内地远非光亮、明亮和中立，在更传统的画廊中可以看到这一点。
The dim lighting and rough, rocky surfaces are a reminder that visitors are three levels underground.
暗淡的光线和粗糙的岩石表面提醒人们参观者在地下有三层

paragraphs.brief: 与你父母一起到画廊去画画是一个有趣的经历；
sentences: The warped, mirrored surface at the museum’s entry could be seen as the start of a journey of reflecting on one’s existence.
博物馆入口处的反射面可被视为反射一个人存在的旅程的开始。
Much of the art explores the human condition – there are uninhibited artistic descriptions of human relationships, death, and even the digestion process.
许多艺术探索人类状况，对人类关系、死亡甚至消化过程的艺术描述是不受限制的。
Going to a gallery with such confronting artworks with your parents is an interesting experience; I was pleasantly surprised by my parents’ openness to the exhibitions.
与你父母一起到画廊去画画是一个有趣的经历；
My father, who normally whisks through a gallery while my mother likes to take her time, happily spent almost five hours at MONA; the urge to linger is a common feeling here.
我的父亲通常在画廊里哭泣，而我妈妈却喜欢花时间，很高兴在MONA度过了将近五个小时；
This is because the gallery engages all of the senses, and visitors often pause to experience the effect each artwork has on them.
这是因为画廊接触所有感官，参观者经常停下来体验每一件艺术作品对他们的影响。
This raises the question of who is actually visiting MONA – and it’s definitely not just the normal gallery-goers.
这引起了谁真的访问MONA的问题 — — 这肯定不仅仅是普通的画廊观众。
People from all kinds of socioeconomic backgrounds are curious about what lies within the subterranean maze of MONA.
来自各种社会经济背景的人都对MONA的地下迷宫存有好奇心
Conservative minds are being opened, which is a good thing anywhere.
保守思想正在被打开，这是一件好事。

paragraphs.brief: Walsh的古董收藏非常出色，但他知道旧硬币会争夺注意力，对抗规模和主题上更具挑战性的新作品，因此，在20世纪和21世纪的作品中设置古董。
sentences: Walsh’s antiquities collection is superb, but he knew that old coins would compete for attention against new works that are more challenging in scale and subject matter, hence the device of setting antiquities among twentieth- and twenty-first-century works.
Walsh的古董收藏非常出色，但他知道旧硬币会争夺注意力，对抗规模和主题上更具挑战性的新作品，因此，在20世纪和21世纪的作品中设置古董。
For me, one of the intriguing outcomes of this strategy was an intensified feeling that the makers of the coins and antiquities were the great contemporary artists of their time.
对于我来说，这一战略的一个令人感兴趣的结果是，人们更加强烈地感到，硬币和古董的制造者是他们时代的伟大当代艺术家。

paragraphs.brief: 所谓的毕尔巴鄂效应对霍巴特产生了魔力，因为正如弗兰克·盖里的古根海姆博物馆改变了西班牙的毕尔巴涛市，莫纳已成为霍巴特旅游者的磁铁。
sentences: The so-called Bilbao Effect has worked its magic on Hobart because, just as Frank Gehry’s Guggenheim Museum has transformed the city of Bilbao in Spain, MONA has been a magnet for tourists in Hobart.
所谓的毕尔巴鄂效应对霍巴特产生了魔力，因为正如弗兰克·盖里的古根海姆博物馆改变了西班牙的毕尔巴涛市，莫纳已成为霍巴特旅游者的磁铁。

However, the architectural ‘wow’ factor of the Guggenheim was the most famous component of that city’s transformation, whereas Fender Katsalidis’s MONA does not have the same spectacular impact as the shimmering metal surfaces of Gehry’s building.
然而，古根海姆的建筑 " wow " 因素是该城市转型中最著名的部分，而芬德·卡萨利迪斯的MONA并没有像盖赫里大楼闪烁的金属表面那样产生惊人的影响。

Walsh himself abhors descriptions of MONA as the Bilbao of the south, saying that Fender Katsalidis solved a problem when he designed MONA, in executing a project of this scale in an underground location.
Walsh本人憎恶将MONA描述为南部的毕尔巴鄂，他说Fender Katsalidis在设计MONA时解决了一个问题，在一个地下地点执行一个规模如此庞大的项目。
Walsh contrasts this with what he describes as the “architectural self-indulgence of Gehry when designing the Guggenheim in Bilbao.”
Walsh将这与他所描述的“盖赫里在毕尔巴鄂设计古根海姆时的建筑设计自我融合”相提并论。
Call it the Bilbao Effect, but this phenomenon has been around for thousands of years – good public architecture forms the centrepiece of a city.
但这种现象已经存在数千年了，良好的公共建筑构成了城市的核心。
This is probably true, but like the Guggenheim, MONA has initiated something very important for Tasmania, and for Hobart in particular.
这或许是真的，但和古根海姆一样，MONA已经发起了一些对塔斯马尼亚，特别是霍巴特非常重要的事情。
Now the question is how Tasmania will build on David Walsh’s input into its cultural setting.
现在的问题是塔斯马尼亚将如何利用David Walsh对文化背景的投入。

items.en: The writer changed her mind about spending time in Tasmania.
items.zh: 作家改变了她的想法在塔斯马尼亚度过时间。
items.why: 先“急着离开”到“期盼回去”,态度反转 = 改变主意，故 YES。

items.en: Andrew Bain believes that the effect MONA had on Hobart was immediate.
items.zh: 安德鲁·班恩认为MONA对霍巴特的影响是直接的
items.why: “in a virtual blink”=了瞬间/立即，与题干一致 YES.

items.en: Other factors have contributed as much as MONA to Hobart’s transformation.
items.zh: 其他因素也与MONA一样，对Hobart的转变起了推动作用。
items.why: “solely instrumental” =单独/最关键。否定“其他因素同样重要”。与题干相反,NO。

items.en: The Tourism Industry Council of Tasmania works closely with the director of MONA.
items.zh: 塔斯马尼亚州旅游业理事会与MONA主任密切合作。
items.why: 文中提到有人研究把 MONA 与其他美术馆串成旅游线路，但未说明旅游业理事会与 MONA 馆长是否保持密切合作。

items.en: Many local residents are writing to The Mercury expressing concern about the length of tourists’ stays in Hobart.
items.zh: 许多当地居民写信给"水星报"表达了对旅游者在霍巴特的逗留时间的担忧。
items.why: 《水星报》报道了对游客停留时长的担忧。报道没有说明这条信息来自居民来信，也没有给出写信人数。

items.en: Tourists now regard MONA as a starting point for longer trips in Tasmania.
items.zh: 旅游者现在将MONA视为在塔斯马尼亚进行较长旅行的起点。
items.why: 吸引游客停留更久并走得更远，仍是塔斯马尼亚下一阶段要解决的难题；文章描述的现状并非游客已把参观博物馆当作长线旅行的起点。

items.zh: Luke Martin计划推广塔斯马尼亚的旅游业,

将前往MONA与参观其他画廊结合起来。

items.en: According to the writer, what is especially interesting about MONA?

correct: visitors’ responses to the gallery spaces
参观者对画廊空间的反应

items.en: Why do visitors spend a long time at the gallery?
items.zh: 为什么参观者要在画廊待很长时间？
correct: The gallery has a physical effect on visitors.

items.en: What does the writer say about the visitors to MONA?
correct: A wide variety of people are interested in MONA.
各种各样的人对MONA感兴趣。

items.en: Why does the writer mention the coins at MONA?
items.zh: 为什么作家提到在MONA的硬币？
correct: to express admiration for the way that the exhibits are presented
来表示钦佩展览的展示方式

lead: Katelin Butler, returning to her home city of Hobart, reflects on how a new museum has brought about change.
卡特林巴特勒回到了家乡霍巴特市思考了新博物馆如何带来变化
